records.action: Handled the empty finite subset separately before choosing a largest stage index in the Lindenbaum consistency proof.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The proof chooses the largest of the finitely many stage indices associated with members of Gamma-prime, but a finite subset may be empty and then has no such largest index.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் நிறுவல் வெற்றுக் கணத்தின் முரணின்மையை முதலில் தனியே கூறி, வெற்றற்ற இறுதிக்குட்பட்ட உட்கணத்திற்கே மீப்பெரிய சுட்டெண்ணைத் தேர்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Silently assuming the finite subset is nonempty; assigning an arbitrary stage to the empty subset without saying so.
records.rationale: The empty subset is consistent trivially. Every nonempty finite subset has finitely many associated natural-number indices and therefore a largest one, after which the source argument applies unchanged.
records.precise_review_question: Does the explicit empty-set case close the only gap before the maximum-index argument without changing the compactness step?

records.action: Used B rather than A in the universal truth-lemma induction conclusion.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The universal induction case is stated for forall-x B(x), and every preceding satisfaction and membership formula uses B, but its final membership formula unexpectedly switches to A.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் நிறுவல் தொகுத்தறிதல் வழக்கின் வாய்பாடு B-ஐ இறுதி அனைத்தளவையிட்ட உறுப்பியச் சூத்திரத்திலும் தொடர்ந்து பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Preserving the isolated A despite the induction case and saturation proposition both using B.
records.rationale: The induction variable A names the whole formula, while B is its immediate quantified subformula; the truth-lemma conclusion must be membership of forall-x B(x).
records.precise_review_question: Does replacing A by B in the final universal-membership formula restore the stated induction case without changing its quantifier or set?

records.rationale: The two explicit uses of zero require a sentinel exception; all positive-label path behavior remains unchanged.
records.precise_review_question: Does the added zero-label disjunct prevent false discharge while preserving the ancestor check for labeled assumptions?

records.action: Added the missing bounded existential j<i around the QR_1 definition.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The QR_1 formula refers to line index j in the bound on c and in (d)_j but never binds j, although the preceding five-item account explicitly requires some line j<i.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வாய்பாடு j<i என்ற வரம்புள்ள இருத்தலளவையீட்டை வெளிப்புறமாகச் சேர்த்து, அதன் முழு உட்பரப்பில் j ஐப் பிணைக்கிறது.

records.action: Made the three-argument hCond step recurse through hCond rather than the two-argument wrapper Cond.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The step clause calls Cond with three arguments even though the next line defines Cond as the two-argument wrapper and hCond as the three-argument recursion helper.

records.rationale: The base clause, step left side and wrapper equation uniquely determine hCond as the recursive helper. The expected display pair also contains the separately audited TA-INC-013 membership repair in the same align environment.
records.precise_review_question: Does the recursive step now reduce n while the public two-argument Cond definition remain unchanged?

records.action: Replaced meta-level membership in Gamma inside the Prf definition with the stated primitive-recursive predicate R_Gamma.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The proof begins by naming R_Gamma(y) as the primitive-recursive test for membership in Gamma, but the final displayed definition reverts to the unanalyzed expression (s)_i in Gamma.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இறுதி வரையறை ஒவ்வொரு முன்னிலைக் குறியீட்டுக்கும் R_Gamma((s)_i) ஐப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.

records.rationale: Substitution of the already supplied characteristic predicate is exactly what establishes primitive recursiveness.
records.precise_review_question: Does the final bounded universal now invoke R_Gamma on each sequence entry and preserve every other Prf conjunct?

records.action: Changed the lemma's witness formula from A to A_f so it agrees with the displayed biconditional and every use in the proof.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The lemma introduces A(x_0,...,x_k,y), but its display and the entire proof use A_f for the same representing formula.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் துணைத்தேற்றம் தொடக்கத்திலிருந்தே பிரதிநிதித்துவ வாய்பாட்டை A_f என்று பெயரிட்டு, காட்டலின் முழுவதும் அதே பெயரைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Changing every later A_f to A; preserving two names for one witness without an equality or renaming clause.
records.rationale: The subscript records dependence on f and is already fixed by the preceding definition, displayed equivalence and all subsequent proof steps.
records.precise_review_question: Does one formula name A_f now denote the witness consistently in the lemma, display and proof?

records.action: Restored the missing Q-proves prefix before the universal uniqueness formula supplied by representability clause (b).
records.source_issue_or_choice: Representability clause (b) says that Q proves the uniqueness formula, but the proof quotes only the bare formula and then needs it as a Q-theorem to infer Q proves numeral equality.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் காட்டல் தனித்தன்மை வாய்பாட்டுக்கு முன் Q நிறுவுகிறது என்பதை மீட்டமைத்து, அடுத்த தருக்கப் படியின் கோட்பாட்டு உட்பரப்பைப் பாதுகாக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Treating the uniqueness formula as a metatheoretic assumption; omitting the later conclusion that Q proves the equality.
records.rationale: The cited definition and the next inference independently require the formula to be derivable in Q, not merely displayed at the meta-level.
records.precise_review_question: Is the uniqueness formula now explicitly a theorem of Q, making the subsequent equality derivation valid?

records.action: Wrapped the decoded output (s)_1 in the numeral constructor in the informal explanation of the searched proof pair.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The relation immediately above substitutes num((s)_1) into the object-language formula through A(...,(s)_1), but the explanatory sentence inserts the meta-level number (s)_1 directly as its final term.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் விளக்கம் குறிவிலக்கப்பட்ட வெளியீடு (s)_1 க்கான எண்ணுருவையே வாய்பாட்டின் இறுதி உட்பொருளாக இடுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Leaving a meta-level number in an object-language formula; removing numeral constructors from the preceding definition and substitution function.
records.rationale: The definition of A and the relation R uniquely determine the syntactic formula whose proof code is being searched.
records.precise_review_question: Does the searched derivation now end in the formula containing the numeral for (s)_1, consistent with A and R?

records.action: Changed the introductory function signature from h(x, vector z) to h(vector x, y), matching both primitive-recursion equations and all subsequent occurrences.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The prose names h(x, vector z), while the immediately following base and step equations, the beta-coded sequence and the final extraction all define h(vector x, y).
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் அறிமுகம் இரு வரையறைச் சமன்பாடுகளிலும் தொடர்ந்து வரும் அதே உட்பொருட்களான வெக்டர் x மற்றும் y ஐக் கொண்ட h ஐப் பெயரிடுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Changing every equation and later construction to x and vector z; preserving an unexplained switch in arity and argument roles.
records.rationale: The base variable y=0, successor step y+1 and final beta extraction uniquely determine the intended signature.
records.precise_review_question: Does h now have the same vector parameters and recursion variable everywhere in the lemma and proof?

records.action: Localized the bare English cases entry 'otherwise' as Tamil text inside the display.

records.action: Replaced the circular middle line with the equality derived from the induction hypothesis, then made the last line the desired conclusion by transitivity.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The frozen induction display labels the desired conclusion itself as following from the induction hypothesis, then derives the intermediate equality from that conclusion and Q5. This reverses the two required steps and makes the reasoning circular.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் காட்டல் தொகுத்தறிதல் எடுகோளிலிருந்து நடுச் சமத்துவத்தை முதலில் பெற்று, அதை step5 உடன் சேர்த்து வேண்டிய சமத்துவத்தை இறுதியில் முடிவுசெய்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping the circular order; adding a separate duplicate derivation while leaving the false justification in place.
records.rationale: Q5 gives the first equality, the induction hypothesis together with successor congruence gives the middle equality, and transitivity then uniquely yields the target.
records.precise_review_question: Do step5 and step6 now compose in the stated order to yield exactly the induction target?

records.action: Changed the prose witness generalized in the trichotomy proof from c-prime to c.
records.source_issue_or_choice: From (c-prime + b-prime) = numeral(m)-prime, the required Q8 witness formula is (u-prime + b-prime) = numeral(m+1). Substitution therefore uses u=c, whereas generalizing on the whole term c-prime would yield u+b-prime instead.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் காட்டல் c மீது இருத்தலளவைப் பொதுமைப்படுத்துகிறது; அப்போது u-prime இடத்தில் c-prime கிடைத்து வேண்டிய Q8 நேர்வு அமைகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Generalizing on c-prime as printed; changing Q8 or the preceding equality.
records.rationale: The syntactic substitution instance of the existential formula uniquely identifies c as the witness term.
records.precise_review_question: Does existential introduction now substitute c for u so that u-prime reproduces the established c-prime term?

records.action: Restored the statement that h is defined from f and g by primitive recursion before invoking the lemma that eliminates primitive recursion.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The cited lemma applies to the function h defined from f and g by primitive recursion, but the frozen sentence merely says h is defined from f and g and thus omits the construction being eliminated.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் காட்டல் h ஆனது f மற்றும் g இலிருந்து முதன்மை மீள்வரையறையால் வரையறுக்கப்படுகிறது என்பதை வெளிப்படையாக மீட்டமைக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Leaving the construction unspecified; weakening the cited lemma into a false claim about every function definable from f and g.
records.rationale: The preceding characterization and the cited primitive-recursion simulation lemma uniquely supply the omitted construction.
records.precise_review_question: Does the sentence now state exactly which primitive-recursive construction is replaced by composition and regular minimization?

records.action: Qualified the converse representability claim and the final comparison of axiomatizable theories by consistency.
records.source_issue_or_choice: A computable derivation system alone does not ensure that every represented function is computable: an inconsistent axiomatizable theory proves every graph formula and its uniqueness clause, so every function becomes representable under the stated definition.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் விளக்கம் கணிக்கத்தக்க வருவித்தல் முறையுடன் முரணின்மையையும் கோருகிறது; இறுதி அடிகோளாக்கத்தக்க கோட்பாடுகள் பற்றிய கூற்றிலும் அதே தகுதியைச் சேர்க்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Retaining the overclaim; silently assuming consistency without stating it; redefining representability.
records.rationale: The immediately preceding proof that representability yields computability explicitly uses consistency, and the standard examples Q, PA and ZF are intended under that same qualification.
records.precise_review_question: Do both general claims now exclude inconsistent derivation systems while preserving the intended comparison across Q, PA and ZF?

records.action: Changed the numeral proved equal to t_2 from n to m, its stipulated value in the standard model.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The proof fixes n as the value of t_1 and m as the value of t_2, but then says Q proves t_2 equals numeral n before splitting into the n=m and n-not-equal-m cases.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் காட்டல் t_2 ஐ அதன் நிலைப்படுத்தப்பட்ட மதிப்பான m இன் எண்குறிக்குச் சமப்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping numeral n, which assumes the equality case before the case distinction; renaming both fixed values.
records.rationale: The closed-term lemma applied to t_2 uniquely yields its own value m.
records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected pair of equalities now support both the equality and inequality cases?

records.action: Changed the closed numeral equality from n plus successor k to successor k plus n so it matches the Q8 witness formula used in the next inference.
records.source_issue_or_choice: Q8 defines x<y using z-prime plus x, but the frozen proof establishes n plus k-prime and then swaps the addends without deriving commutativity in Q.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் காட்டல் மூடிய சொல் துணைத்தேற்றத்தை நேரடியாக k-prime plus n என்ற வரிசையில் பயன்படுத்தி, அடுத்த Q8 நேர்வுடன் பொருந்தச் செய்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Assuming unproved global commutativity in Q; adding a separate commutativity lemma not available here.
records.rationale: Both closed terms have value m, so atomic completeness directly proves the correctly ordered equality without any commutativity principle.
records.precise_review_question: Does substituting t_1 for numeral n now yield exactly successor witness plus t_1 equals t_2?

records.action: Changed both contradiction citations from Q3 to Q2, the axiom that no successor equals zero.
records.source_issue_or_choice: Both contradictions have the form successor equals zero. Q2 states x-prime is not zero, whereas Q3 states that every nonzero number is a successor.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரண்டு முரண்பாட்டுப் படிகளிலும் வழிவரு சுழிக்குச் சமமல்ல என்று கூறும் Q_2 ஐச் சுட்டுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Retaining Q3; changing the contradiction formulas to fit Q3.
records.rationale: The displayed contradictions instantiate Q2 directly and do not instantiate Q3.
records.precise_review_question: Do both axiom citations now justify the exact successor-equals-zero contradictions displayed?

records.action: Changed empty disjunction to empty conjunction in the zero-bound base case for the bounded universal formula.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The lemma's first clause expands a bounded universal formula into a finite conjunction, and at bound zero that conjunction is true; the frozen proof instead calls it an empty disjunction while assigning it the truth constant.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் அனைத்தளவை நேர்வுக்குரிய வெற்று இணைப்பை மெய் மாறிலியாக எடுத்துக்கொள்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping empty disjunction while calling it true; switching to the existential clause.
records.rationale: An empty conjunction is true and is exactly the k=0 instance of the conjunction on the right side of clause one.
records.precise_review_question: Does the base case now name the same Boolean operation used in the lemma's universal clause?

records.action: Wrapped A(x) as the second argument of the bounded existential macro under negation.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The bounded existential macro requires a bound argument and a matrix argument, but the frozen expression leaves A(x) outside the macro braces.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வெளிப்பாடு A(x) ஐ வரம்பிட்ட இருத்தலளவை மேட்ரிக்சாக இரண்டாம் கட்டளையுருப்பில் வைக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Leaving the matrix outside the macro; rewriting the bounded quantifier in expanded ordinary-existential form.
records.rationale: The companion bounded formulas throughout the section and the stated macro convention fix the intended two-argument syntax.
records.precise_review_question: Is A(x) now scoped by the bounded existential quantifier exactly as required by the duality step?

records.action: Changed the opening Sigma-one witness formula in the final proof to the documented two-optional-argument lexists syntax.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The final proof begins with lexists using a mandatory brace argument followed by an unscoped formula, while the definition and concluding line use the documented optional variable and matrix arguments.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இறுதிக் காட்டல் வரையறையிலும் முடிவிலும் உள்ள அதே lexists[x][A(x)] வடிவைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping malformed syntax; altering the definition and conclusion to match it.
records.rationale: The macro declaration and every surrounding well-formed occurrence uniquely determine the intended syntax and scope.
records.precise_review_question: Does the proof now begin and end with the same well-scoped Sigma-one existential sentence?

records.action: Added the missing opening parenthesis before the fourth list-item reference.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The fourth item ends its theorem reference with a closing parenthesis but has no matching opening parenthesis, unlike the preceding three parallel items.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் நான்காம் பட்டியல் உறுப்பிலும் மேற்கோளைப் பொருந்திய அடைப்புக்குறிகளுக்குள் வைக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Deleting the unmatched closing parenthesis; preserving inconsistent punctuation.
records.rationale: The three preceding items and the identical syntactic role of the fourth reference fix the intended punctuation.
records.precise_review_question: Does the fourth theorem reference now follow the same balanced pattern as the other three?

records.action: Replaced two uses of the formula metavariable A_x applied to x with the indexed partial-computation notation cfind_x(x) defined.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The diagonal halting set K was defined earlier by definedness of the indexed partial function cfind_x(x), but this proof twice applies a down-arrow to the logical formula metavariable A_x.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் K இன் முன் வரையறையிலுள்ள சுட்டெண் சார்பின் வரையறுக்கப்பட்ட தன்மைக் குறிமுறையையே இரு இடங்களிலும் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Treating A_x as an unexplained program notation; redefining K locally with a formula.
records.rationale: The cited many-one completeness result and Kleene T equivalence both concern the established self-halting set.
records.precise_review_question: Do the definition of K and the converse conclusion now use the same indexed-computation notation?

records.action: Replaced both final occurrences of the metatheoretic Kleene predicate T inside the claimed Q sentence with its representing formula A_T.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The proof introduces A_T as the arithmetic formula representing Kleene's external relation T and uses it throughout the reduction, but the final summary and coded sentence revert to T with numeral arguments.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் Q நிறுவும் வாக்கியத்திலும் அதன் குறியீட்டைத் தரும் சார்பிலும் பிரதிநிதித்துவ வாய்பாடு A_T ஐ வைத்திருக்கிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Adding T as an unexplained symbol to the language of arithmetic; replacing the earlier representation proof with a richer language.
records.rationale: Only A_T belongs to the stated language and is the formula whose Q-provability was established immediately above.
records.precise_review_question: Does the reduction function now code exactly the arithmetic sentence proved equivalent to self-halting?

records.action: Changed both evaluations of the external relation S from the object-language numeral for n to the natural number n.
records.source_issue_or_choice: S is introduced as a computable relation on natural numbers, while D_S is its object-language representing formula. The two equivalence displays apply S itself to numeral n rather than n.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மேக்கோட்பாட்டு S ஐ n இல் மதிப்பிட்டு, D_S க்கு மட்டும் எண்குறி num n ஐப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Treating S as an object-language predicate symbol; removing numeral constructors from D_S.
records.rationale: The definition of relation representability fixes the separation between external inputs and internal numeral terms.
records.precise_review_question: Do both positive and negative equivalences now distinguish S(n) from D_S(num n)?

records.action: Changed the simultaneous proof searches from the whole theory T to its stipulated computable axiom set A.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The proof assumes a computable axiom set A but then tells the algorithm to search for a derivation from T, whose membership is exactly what the algorithm is meant to decide.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் படிமுறை கணிக்கத்தக்க அடிகோள் கணம் A இலிருந்து இரு வருவித்தல்களையும் தேடுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Using T as an oracle; assuming the theorem set is already decidable.
records.rationale: Effective enumeration of derivations from A is supplied by axiomatizability and is the premise needed for the dovetailed search.
records.precise_review_question: Does the algorithm now rely only on the computable axiom set rather than presupposing theorem membership?

records.action: Rendered the proof premise as axiomatizable, matching both the theorem statement and the immediately preceding decidability lemma; retained the frozen token key in an alignment comment.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The proof says merely axiomatized where its inference to decidability requires a computable axiomatization, expressed everywhere else as axiomatizable.

records.action: Changed the proof's final description from subsets of s(Z) to subsets of s(X).
records.source_issue_or_choice: The proof explains a formula whose only set parameters at that stage are X and Y, but its final sentence refers to subsets of s(Z); Z is only a locally quantified coding variable in the preceding definition.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் நிறுவல் s(Y) இன் உறுப்புகளை s(X) இன் உட்கணங்களுடன் தொடர்புபடுத்துகிறது என்று சரியான அடுக்குக்கண அளவுருவைக் கூறுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping the unbound prose variable Z; replacing X in the displayed formula, where it is already correct.
records.rationale: Pow(Y,R,X) explicitly says that Y codes the powerset of X, so the final injectivity condition associates Y-elements with subsets of X.
records.precise_review_question: Does the final proof sentence now describe the same X-parametrized powerset coding relation as the displayed formula?

records.action: Restricted both comparison formulas' injectivity requirement to arguments in X.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The frozen formulas demand that a total ambient-domain function be injective everywhere, which is stronger than the stated existence of an injection from X to Y and can fail solely because the complement of X is too large.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வாய்பாடுகள் u இன் மதிப்புகள் X இலிருந்து Y க்குச் செல்கின்றன என்றும், X இல் உள்ள உள்ளீடுகள்மீது மட்டும் u உட்செலுத்துவதாகும் என்றும் கூறுகின்றன.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping global injectivity; introducing partial-function semantics absent from the chapter.
records.rationale: A total second-order function variable can represent an injection with restricted domain X exactly by guarding both injectivity arguments with X membership.
records.precise_review_question: Do both corrected formulas now characterize |X|≤|Y| and |X|=|Y| without constraints on u outside X?

records.action: Required the witness to map X into X and to be injective only on X.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The frozen formula makes u globally injective but never requires values of X-elements to remain in X, so it does not state that u is an injective nonsurjective self-map of X.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வாய்பாடு X இன் கீழ் மூடுதலையும் X-இல் கட்டுப்படுத்தப்பட்ட உட்செலுத்துதலையும் சேர்த்து டெடெகிண்ட் முடிவிலாதன்மையைத் துல்லியமாகக் கூறுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Retaining global injectivity with no closure; treating u as partial despite standard function-variable semantics.
records.rationale: The preceding domain-level criterion requires exactly an injective nonsurjective map X→X.
records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected formula hold exactly when s(X) has an injective nonsurjective self-map?

records.action: Closed the outer implication before closing its universal quantifier.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The frozen Pow formula closes the inner universal quantifier but omits the parenthesis closing Y(x) implies that universal condition.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வாய்பாடு வெளிப்புற நிபந்தனைவாக்கியத்தின் அடைப்புக்குறியை அளவையடை முடிவதற்கு முன் மூடுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Preserving the unbalanced formula; deleting the converse coding clause.
records.rationale: Balancing the clause yields the prose-stated condition that every Y-element codes only a subset of X.
records.precise_review_question: Is every bracket and parenthesis in the corrected Pow definition balanced with the intended scope?

records.action: Restricted the prohibited injection to the coded powerset domain Y.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The frozen Cantor formula rules out only functions injective on the entire ambient domain, which need not rule out an injection from the coded powerset subset Y into X.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வாய்பாடு Y இல் உள்ள இரு உள்ளீடுகளுக்கே உட்செலுத்துதலைக் கோருகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping ambient injectivity; requiring u(Y)=X, which would express bijection rather than injection.
records.rationale: Cantor's theorem denies an injection from the powerset coding domain Y to X, independent of u outside Y.
records.precise_review_question: Does the corrected sentence rule out every injection Y→X represented by a total ambient function?

records.action: Required unique subset codes and a bijection from the entire domain onto their coding set Y.
records.source_issue_or_choice: The frozen formula permits duplicate codes, does not require the range of u to stay in Y, and requires only that Y lie inside the range; these conditions do not establish a bijection between the domain and a continuum-sized set.
records.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வாய்பாடு Y இல் குறியீடுகள் தனித்தவையாகவும், u பொருட்களம் முழுவதிலிருந்தும் Y க்கு உட்செலுத்தும் மேற்கோர்த்தலாகவும் இருக்க வேண்டும் என்று கூறுகிறது.
records.alternatives_considered: Keeping the one-sided range condition; reusing Cont(Y) while leaving its domain-size hypothesis external.
records.rationale: Unique coding makes Y equipotent with the powerset of a countable X, and the three u clauses express a bijection from Domain(M) onto Y.
records.precise_review_question: Do unique codes plus the range, injectivity and surjectivity clauses prove exactly |Domain(M)|=|R|?
